The PREDICTION (pred_MeV) is the INDEPENDENT categorical value m_μ = m_e·Vol(4_1)/ℏ_q² from the Borromean witness — post the 2026-05-29 q₀ re-pin it is a genuine 9.5σ PREDICTION, NOT ratio-derived. The ~210 ppb pred-vs-codata gap (963.6× the 100× target) is the real μ-p tension; m_μ does NOT meet L2. Do not read 'ratio-derived' as 'm_μ trivially meets' (the error PR #1556 made).

rows.source_witness: Q_N2 from qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json (deepest DERIVED-tier rung). c_2 = -1 PROVED via qou:QOU.BraidKnot.q_beta_categorical_precision_ladder + Kashiwara N2_factor. Higher c_k are tier='cal-anchored' (extracted from CODATA Q_β, circular, q₀-dependent) — cached for downstream reuse but NOT credited as a prediction. See deep audit docs/audits/2026-05-30-qbeta-ck-mp-dk-deep-audit.md and qbeta-scaling-bridge-investigation.witness.json. ⚠ CONVENTION FRAME: this prediction was built in Markov convention C, which the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 EXCISED in favour of D (z = q³/(q²+1)). The induced error is NOT quantified here and that is deliberate: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under D, so no D-frame counterpart exists to difference against — this figure is currently UNREPRODUCIBLE under the canonical convention. Re-derivation is tracked as bean qou-cds1 and is not a z-swap (the 2026-08-30 bar-weight prune showed the obstruction is the offset, not z). Applies to the m_n and Δ_pn rows too, which are derived from this value. 🛑 FUNCTIONAL ADMISSIBILITY (separate from, and stronger than, the convention-frame note above): the base closed form this ladder sits on solves to Markov parameter z = 1, which is NOT one of the admissible roots under convention D (q, q**3/(q**2 + 1)) — ConventionDAdmissibleRoots.lean, sorry-free, and qbeta-published-form-is-the-inadmissible-z1.witness.json (15/15, exact over Q(q)). The best ADMISSIBLE cell is 12.470022% (the augmentation on Delta_S) against the published 0.16776% -- 74.3x worse, BASE TO BASE. Do NOT relate either to the value scored here: that is post-ladder, and no ladder exists on an admissible base (qou-cds1), so what it would become is UNKNOWN. Which functional to adopt is an open owner decision (bean qou-99qc).

convention_frame_qbeta.cache_note: Convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(1+q)), reached only via --historical-convention-C. C was excised by owner ruling (2026-08-09, re-affirmed 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-26); this artifact is retained because 10 consumers read it, including the L2 dashboard per_observable_100x_status.py. The DEFAULT (convention D) path REFUSES: no D-frame ladder has been derived, so there is no D-frame c_k to emit (bean qou-cds1). Substituting z_D into alpha = (z-1)h/2 is proved invalid by QOU.QBeta.decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero and QOU.QBeta.eigenphase_bar_defect_of_fullBar.
convention_frame_qbeta.induced_error_unquantifiable_reason: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under convention D ('convention D has no derived c_k ladder'), so no D-frame counterpart of this prediction exists to difference against.

functional_admissibility_qbeta.note: STRONGER THAN THE CONVENTION-FRAME NOTE, AND SEPARATE FROM IT. That note says the c_k LADDER is convention-C. This says the BASE the ladder sits on uses a functional convention D provably excludes: the published closed form solves to z = 1, which is not a root of the (1^3) weight numerator. The best ADMISSIBLE cell is +12.47% (the augmentation on Delta_S) against the published 0.16776% -- 74.3x worse, BASE TO BASE. Do NOT relate either to the 1279 ppb scored here: that is the post-ladder value, and no ladder has been derived on an admissible base, so what it would become is UNKNOWN. Which functional to adopt is an open owner decision (seven options, docs/audits/2026-09-05-qbeta-functional-decision-options.md, bean qou-99qc); that the scored value rests on an excluded one is true under all of them. Applies to the m_n and Delta_pn rows, which are derived from this value -- and unlike the convention note, it is written ONTO those rows rather than cross-referenced from this one.

caveats: Q_β / m_n / Δ_pn rows: these figures were built in Markov convention C (z = √q/(q+1)), which the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 excised in favour of the canonical D (z = q³/(q²+1)). The upstream qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json carries that stamp; this dashboard published the numbers without it, which is the defect being fixed here (bean qou-zzwm). NO induced-error figure is given, deliberately: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under D, so no D-frame counterpart exists to difference against and any number here would be manufactured. These figures are therefore UNREPRODUCIBLE under the canonical convention. Re-derivation is bean qou-cds1 and is NOT a z-swap — the 2026-08-30 bar-weight prune showed the obstruction is the offset (α = (z−1)h/2 mixes bar-weight −4 with weight 0), not z. This caveat makes the inherited frame visible; it does not change any value.
